name: application-14
title: Workflow builder
description: An Alderbank workflow builder: an email triage flow on a canvas that pans and zooms, a palette that adds a step where you point, an inspector that sets up each kind of step, and undo and redo that walk every edit. A test run travels down the flow step by step: the branch it takes fills with the primary colour while the others dim, a carrier call fails once then passes on its second try, the reply streams in the inspector and a refund waits for Allow or Deny on its step. Plug your backend into onRun, onSave, onPublish, onApprove, onDeny and onChange.
